title: Droplet Dielectrophoresis & Field Code Validation
description: Rigorous mathematical verification of our boundary element electrostatic solver against exact analytical solutions for a droplet subjected to a non-uniform divergent electric field. Subplots show: (a) Applied field $\mathbf{E}_\infty$ & potential $\Phi_\infty$; (b) Field magnitude $|\mathbf{E}|/E_c$; (c) Normal electric field continuity $E_n$ matching exact theory; (d) Free surface charge density $q(\theta)$ across polar angles $\theta \in [0^\circ, 180^\circ]$.
